dex.text: Sits cross-legged high up in the cathedral, one knee hugged to its chest, grinning down at the choir. It has been told off by an angel once and has clearly learnt nothing from it.
dex.fact: The Lincoln Imp is a small carving in the Angel Choir of Lincoln Cathedral, made in the 13th century. Legend says the Devil sent two imps to cause trouble; one tripped up the bishop and smashed the furniture until an angel turned it to stone. Lincoln City FC are nicknamed the Imps.
